definitions.explanation: The time shortly after noon, roughly 1:00–3:00 PM. Often evokes a languid, peaceful atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {昼下|ひるさ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk in the park in the early afternoon.

examples.japanese: {昼下|ひるさ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a book at a café in the early afternoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧{昼下|ひるさ}がり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{木陰|こかげ}→木陰：05043_kokage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気持|きも}ちよさそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}っていた→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: On a hot early afternoon, a cat was sleeping contentedly in the shade of a tree.

notes:
USAGE:
{昼下|ひるさ}がり refers to the time just past noon and is often used in literary or descriptive contexts to evoke a relaxed, drowsy atmosphere. It typically modifies a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

FORMS:
⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ (midday) + {下|さ}がり (past, after). Compare ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧ (afternoon), which is more neutral and precise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼下|ひるさ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧: an early-afternoon park
- {昼下|ひるさ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧: the town in early afternoon
- ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧{昼下|ひるさ}がり: a hot early afternoon
